summary: North American Construction Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 8-K) disclosing the appointment of Brad Rogers as President, Chief Executive Officer and Director effective December 1, 2026, succeeding Barry Palmer. The appointment concludes a multi-month global search supported by a leading executive recruitment firm and was announced by Board Chair Martin Ferron. Rogers currently serves as CEO and Managing Director of ASX-listed Jupiter Mines and previously led Bis Industries. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor mandate or regulatory clock is stated; no deal terms disclosed.
